# Form Factory Hybrid Games – Hybrid Challenge in Prague (5 December 2026)

> Form Factory Hybrid Games is an individual fitness race at Form Factory Vinohradská (Vinohradská 190, Praha 3, Czech Republic) on Saturday 5 December 2026, 9:00–11:00: one workout (Hybrid Challenge, 5 stations × 4:00), 2 divisions, up to 40 athletes, followed by a Christmas party. Organized by STR2G and Form Factory; head organizer Ladislav Suchánek.

## Key facts
- Date: Saturday 5 December 2026, check-in 9:00, first heat 9:30, awards 10:52–11:00, Christmas party after
- Venue: Form Factory Vinohradská, Vinohradská 190, 130 00 Praha 3, Czech Republic
- Format: Hybrid Challenge, 5 stations, each a 4:00 AMRAP with 1:30 transition; heats of 4 athletes, a new heat every 5:30; one run-through takes 26 minutes
- Stations (women/men): A 10/12 cal SkiErg + 15 wall balls 4/6 kg; B 7/10 cal Echo Bike + 15 alternating DB snatches 12.5/15 kg; C 12.5 m sled push + 12.5 m sled pull 150/200 kg incl. sled; D 10/12 cal RowErg + 15 burpees over rower; E 6 × 12.5 m shuttle run + 2 × 12.5 m sandbag walking lunges 10/20 kg
- Scoring: points per station = 100 × (N − rank) / (N − 1) within the division; total = sum of 5 stations, max 500
- Divisions: Women, Men
- Capacity: 40 athletes in total; heats and lanes sent by email after registration closes
